authority.user_instruction: Package, replay, render, publish, verify, and terminally close Experiment Three without changing lifecycle PASS or comparative FAIL.

scope.objective: Build reviewer-facing evidence, verify clean-context replay, publish one rights-safe v1.0.0 GitHub release, verify every live surface, and close the experiment without changing the frozen result.
forbidden_work: Change scientific code, protocol, model, checkpoints, threshold, seed, comparator, metric, collapse gate, decision, or terminal package

Publish benchmark arrays, source imagery, labels, historical comparator arrays, checkpoints, predictions, probabilities, GeoTIFFs, the imagery-bearing test render, private review material, runtime, credentials, or secrets
Create more than one GitHub release
reversible_actions: Generate public-safe architecture, curve, metric, and narrative evidence
Build and verify deterministic public release archives
Run full scientific replay read-only against controlled custody
Create and verify one annotated tag and GitHub release after audit pass
stop_conditions: A scientific or claim change is required
A release asset would contain a forbidden byte
A tag or release target is ambiguous
A new source, dependency, credential, spend, access, destructive action, or unsupported claim is required

evidence: Goal explicitly authorizes reviewer packaging, exact replay, versioning, tags, release publication, live verification, and terminal closeout
Public records and repository-authored software/docs permitted
Release exclusion boundary explicit in issue #12 and this contract
M6 contract valid with zero errors after retained structural corrections
Three deterministic numerical SVGs and nine-artifact public evidence manifest
Architecture, all-seed curves, and comparison attempt 002 directly inspected
Zero embedded images and zero forbidden binary extensions in repository
Zero forbidden tracked binary files and zero common secret-pattern matches

units.purpose: Bind accepted M5 and activate the exact release/rights boundary.
retained_failures: Initial profile validation rejected the non-schema risk token rendered and missing records/release receipt root; both structural defects were corrected before any release asset was built.
Initial milestone validation rejected terminal as a non-schema decision_value; the planned unit now uses the valid enables_dependency value.

exit_condition_delta.rationale: Accepted M5, authority, rights exclusions, profile, contract, reconciliation, repository controls, and tests now pass.

units.purpose: Create public-safe reviewer narrative, architecture, curves, comparison, benchmark card, model card, limitations, and reproducibility instructions.
outputs: Reviewer evidence surfaces and machine-readable manifest
retained_failures: Comparison preview attempt 001 retained after label collision; only vertical spacing changed for accepted attempt 002.

exit_condition_delta.rationale: The public evidence explains the architecture, all histories, all seeds/controls, frozen outcome, rights exclusions, and replay limits without controlled bytes.

units.purpose: Build deterministic release assets, verify a clean extraction, replay the scientific package from clean code context and controlled custody, and complete the candidate release audit.
retained_failures: Clean-context attempt 001 at commit 3847d91b6c82e06ddd75d3ab8c15baa16b499ab0 retained: Windows checkout CRLF conversion changed six hash-bound text surfaces. Scientific replay and the previously built package passed; repository controls failed closed. Bounded remediation adds an explicit LF checkout policy without changing scientific content.

exit_condition_delta.rationale: The exact rights-safe asset reproduced across three builds, the clean extraction and controlled scientific replay passed, and the release audit is verified.

units.purpose: Merge and live-verify the exact release candidate before tagging.
outputs: Reviewed merge commit and main CI

exit_condition_delta.rationale: The tag and release must target an exact accepted reviewed commit.

units.purpose: Create one annotated tag and GitHub release from the accepted release commit, download and verify every live asset and public surface.

exit_condition_delta.rationale: A release exists only after direct live verification.

units.purpose: Reconcile terminal truth on main, close issue #12 and the active goal, and leave no continuation work.

exit_condition_delta.rationale: The experiment ends after live release truth is recorded; no Experiment 3B work is inferred.

fallbacks.trigger: A deterministic packaging, documentation, render, or schema defect is found before tagging
fallbacks.action: Retain the failed attempt, repair only the bounded non-scientific defect, and rerun the affected audit

fallbacks.trigger: The tag or release cannot be independently verified after creation
fallbacks.action: Retain exact external state and stop before claiming release; do not delete or retarget without owner approval

completed_checks: Accepted M5 live identity and CI verified
Reviewer evidence and direct inspection pass
Clean extraction and clean-context scientific replay pass

handoff.current_checkpoint: M5 is accepted live. M6 reviewer evidence, deterministic package, clean extraction, detached clean-context scientific replay, and candidate release audit pass; lifecycle PASS and comparative FAIL remain immutable.
handoff.next_action: Publish the audited candidate through a checked pull request, merge only on passing CI, and verify live main before tagging.
do_not_carry_forward: Any claim of public-download full scientific reproducibility
